flags: No documented price revision found for the Nissan Tekton between its July 2026 launch and 2026-10-31; whether Nissan passed the 22 Sep 2026 GST benefit to Tekton could not be confirmed from any sourced report.

Nissan Magnite KURO Special Edition (black-themed special edition) is deliberately excluded from launches per schema: first launched ~Oct 2023 on the pre-facelift car at Rs 8.27 lakh ex-showroom; a second facelift-based KURO Special Edition launched 2025-08-06 at Rs 8.30 lakh ex-showroom (Delhi). Neither counts as New nameplate / New generation / Major facelift / EV derivative.

Magnite authorised CNG retrofit kit (dealer-fit, government-approved vendor Motozen) was introduced as a variant addition in 2025 and is not counted as a launch; its kit price was Rs 74,999 at introduction and was cut to Rs 71,999 effective 2026-09-22 post-GST.

The Jan 2025 price revision is recorded only as a model note because no sourced report gave exact per-variant figures (only range-level 2% / Rs 8,000-22,000), so no per-variant price_change records were created for it.

Live Magnite prices on zigwheels.com as of 2026-10-12 (used in verifiedData.ts) differ marginally from the post-GST announced figures for some variants (e.g. Visia Petrol MT 568000 vs 561600 post-GST announced), suggesting rounding or a minor later revision; not recorded as price changes because no source/date confirms them.
Pre-facelift (Oct 2023 - Sep 2024) Magnite price revisions were not researched in detail; the Oct 2024 facelift reset the range, and only the two notable post-facelift revisions are recorded.
No EV derivative of the Magnite or Tekton was introduced in India in the window.

launches.notes: Facelifted Magnite introduced with revised grille/bumper, dual-tone copper-black interior, 6 airbags standard, EZ-Shift AMT added to NA petrol. Rs 5.99 lakh was introductory pricing for the first 10,000 deliveries only. Full facelift price range at launch: Rs 5.99-11.50 lakh ex-showroom.

All-new C-segment SUV (badge-engineered on Renault Duster platform, India-developed for global export). Six variants (Visia/Visia Plus/Acenta/N-Connecta/Tekna/Tekna Plus), 1.0L T160 and 1.3L T280 turbo-petrol engines. Launch price range Rs 10.49-18.59 lakh ex-showroom.

model_notes.note: Introductory pricing (first 10,000 deliveries of the facelift) ended in Jan 2025; prices raised by ~2% (Rs 8,000-22,000 depending on variant) effective 2025-01-01. Sources: https://www.rushlane.com/new-nissan-magnite-lhd-sees-global-demand-10000-units-shipment-12517510.html, https://www.CarBike360.com/news/new-nissan-magnite-prices-to-increase-by-2-and-introductory-prices-end-soon

Entire Magnite range repriced effective 2026-09-22 after the GST 2.0 cut (sub-4m petrol: 28% GST + 1% cess -> 18%). Nissan passed the full benefit; prices cut up to Rs 1,00,400 (Tekna Plus Turbo CVT). Entry Visia MT down from Rs 6,14,000 to Rs 5,61,600. Source: https://www.cartrade.com/news/nissan-magnite-prices-reduced-by-up-to-rs-1-lakh-after-gst-cut/

price_changes.notes: GST 2.0 revision; was Rs 11,40,000 before; cut of ~Rs 97,300.
GST 2.0 revision; was Rs 11,76,000 before; cut of ~Rs 1,00,400, the largest.
